q: My grandmother grows several types of vegetables in her garden, including _____ and carrots.
explain: cabbages (n. 卷心菜 复数形式)。
translation: 我奶奶在菜园里种了好几种蔬菜，包括卷心菜和胡萝卜。

q: We usually eat lunch at the school _____ because the food is affordable and convenient.
translation: 我们通常在学校自助餐厅吃午饭，因为那里便宜又方便。

q: She sat by the window in the small _____, sipping her coffee while reading a novel.
translation: 她坐在小咖啡馆的窗边，一边喝咖啡一边读小说。

q: The zookeeper opened the _____ to let the injured bird stretch its wings.
translation: 动物园管理员打开笼子，让受伤的鸟伸展翅膀。

q: For her birthday, we baked a chocolate _____ with strawberry frosting.
translation: 她生日时，我们烤了一个巧克力蛋糕，上面涂了草莓糖霜。

q: Before making any investment, you should carefully _____ the potential risks and returns.
translation: 在做任何投资之前，你都应该仔细计算潜在的风险和回报。

q: I marked the exam date on my desk _____ so I wouldn't forget it.
translation: 我在日历上标记了考试日期，以免忘记。

q: My mom will _____ me when she arrives at the train station.
translation: 我妈妈到火车站时会给我打电话。

q: I missed your _____ this morning because my phone was on silent mode.
translation: 我今天早上没接到你的电话，因为我的手机调成了静音模式。

q: Chinese _____ is not just writing—it is considered a form of fine art.
translation: 中国书法不仅仅是书写——它被视为一种美术形式。

q: Despite the storm outside, she remained surprisingly _____ and focused on her work.
translation: 尽管外面风雨大作，她仍然出奇地平静，专注于工作。

q: This smoothie contains about 250 _____, so it makes a light breakfast.
explain: calories (n. 卡路里 复数形式)。
translation: 这个冰沙大约含有250卡路里，所以作为轻早餐正合适。

q: A _____ can survive for days without water, making it ideal for desert travel.
translation: 骆驼可以几天不喝水，这使它非常适合沙漠旅行。

q: The photographer adjusted the _____ settings before taking the portrait.
translation: 摄影师在拍摄肖像之前调整了相机设置。

q: We set up our tent at the mountain _____ just before sunset.
translation: 我们赶在日落前在山地营地搭起了帐篷。

q: My family loves to _____ by the lake every summer.
translation: 我家人每年夏天都喜欢在湖边露营。

q: The environmental group launched a public awareness _____ to reduce plastic waste.
translation: 这个环保组织发起了一场公众意识运动，以减少塑料垃圾。

q: The university _____ is beautiful in autumn when the maple trees turn red.
translation: 秋天枫叶变红时，这座大学校园非常美丽。

q: Venice is famous for its beautiful waterways, and the Grand _____ is the most well-known.
translation: 威尼斯以其美丽的水道而闻名，大运河是最著名的。

q: We had to _____ the outdoor picnic because of the heavy rain.
translation: 因为大雨，我们不得不取消户外野餐。

q: Regular exercise and a healthy diet can help reduce the risk of developing _____.
translation: 定期锻炼和健康饮食有助于降低患癌症的风险。

q: The _____ gave a strong speech about education reform during the debate.
translation: 这位候选人在辩论中就教育改革发表了有力的演讲。

q: She lit a scented _____ in the living room to create a relaxing atmosphere.
translation: 她在客厅点燃了一支香薰蜡烛，营造放松的氛围。

q: The children filled their bags with _____ after trick-or-treating on Halloween.
explain: candy (n. 糖果，不可数/集合用法)。
translation: 万圣节要完糖果后，孩子们把袋子里装满了糖果。

q: The factory workers gather at the _____ during lunch break to chat and eat together.
translation: 工厂工人们午休时聚集在食堂一起聊天吃饭。

q: He wore a baseball _____ to shield his eyes from the bright sun.
translation: 他戴了一顶棒球帽来遮挡刺眼的阳光。

q: She is a highly _____ manager who can handle multiple projects at once.
translation: 她是一位非常有能力的经理，可以同时处理多个项目。

q: The stadium has a seating _____ of over 50,000 spectators.
translation: 这座体育场的座位容量超过5万名观众。

q: Paris is the _____ of France and also its largest city.
translation: 巴黎是法国的首都，也是其最大的城市。

q: The company plans to raise more _____ to expand its business overseas.
translation: 公司计划筹集更多资本以拓展海外业务。

q: The astronaut spent three months living in the space _____ before returning to Earth.
translation: 宇航员在太空舱里生活了三个月才返回地球。

q: The ship's _____ announced that we would arrive at the port in two hours.
translation: 船长宣布我们将于两小时后抵达港口。

q: We decided to drive to the coast because taking the _____ was more convenient than the train.
translation: 我们决定开车去海边，因为坐汽车比坐火车更方便。

q: Many countries are trying to reduce _____ emissions to fight climate change.
translation: 许多国家正在努力减少碳排放以应对气候变化。

q: She sent me a handwritten birthday _____ instead of a text message.
translation: 她给我寄了一张手写的生日贺卡，而不是发短信。

q: I don't really _____ what others think about my fashion choices.
explain: care (v. 关心/在意 原形)。
translation: 我不太在乎别人怎么看我的穿衣选择。

q: The nurse took excellent _____ of the elderly patients in the hospital.
translation: 护士对医院里的老年病人照顾得很好。

q: After graduating, she began her _____ as a software engineer at a tech company.
translation: 毕业后，她在一家科技公司开始了软件工程师的职业生涯。

q: Be _____ when crossing the street, especially during rush hour.
translation: 过马路时要小心，尤其是在高峰时段。

q: His _____ mistake cost the team the championship in the final minute.
translation: 他粗心的错误让球队在最后一分钟输掉了冠军。

q: The hotel room had a soft red _____ that felt warm under my feet.
translation: 酒店房间里铺着一块柔软的红地毯，踩上去很温暖。

q: She added chopped _____ and celery to the soup for extra flavor.
explain: carrots (n. 胡萝卜 复数形式)。
translation: 她往汤里加了切碎的胡萝卜和芹菜，增添风味。

q: The porter helped us _____ our heavy luggage up to the hotel room.
explain: carry (v. 携带/搬运 原形)。
translation: 行李员帮我们搬沉重的行李到酒店房间。

q: My younger brother watches a _____ about a talking cat every Saturday morning.
translation: 我弟弟每个周六早上都看一部关于会说话的小猫的卡通片。

q: The artist spent weeks _____ the wooden sculpture by hand.
explain: carving (v. 雕刻/切割 现在分词/动名词)。
translation: 这位艺术家花了数周时间手工雕刻这座木雕。

q: In this _____, the judge ruled that the evidence was not strong enough.
translation: 在这起案件中，法官裁定证据不够充分。

q: The small restaurant only accepts _____ and does not take credit cards.
translation: 这家小餐馆只收现金，不接受信用卡。

q: The director _____ a young unknown actor in the lead role of the film.
explain: cast (v. 选派演员 过去式，cast 的过去式同形)。
translation: 导演选派了一位年轻的无名演员担任电影主角。

q: The entire _____ of the Broadway show gave an outstanding performance.
translation: 这部百老汇剧目的全体演员阵容奉献了一场精彩的演出。

q: The medieval _____ on the hilltop offers a stunning view of the surrounding countryside.
translation: 山顶上的中世纪城堡可以俯瞰周围乡村的壮丽景色。

q: Our neighbor's _____ likes to sleep on our porch every afternoon.
translation: 邻居家的猫每天下午都喜欢在我们门廊上睡觉。

q: The dog ran so fast that I couldn't _____ it before it reached the street.
explain: catch (v. 抓住/追上 原形)。
translation: 狗跑得太快了，我在它跑到街上之前没能追上它。

q: The books in the library are organized by _____, such as fiction, history, and science.
translation: 图书馆里的书籍按类别整理，如小说、历史和科学。

q: The farmer raises _____ on his ranch, selling both milk and beef.
explain: cattle (n. 牛，复数名词，单复数同形)。
translation: 这位农场主在他的牧场养牛，出售牛奶和牛肉。

q: The doctor is still trying to determine the _____ of the patient's sudden illness.
translation: 医生仍在努力确定病人突然发病的原因。

q: The heavy rain _____ severe flooding in several parts of the city.
explain: caused (v. 导致/造成 过去式)。
translation: 大雨导致城市多个地区发生了严重洪灾。

q: The explorers discovered an ancient _____ filled with prehistoric paintings.
translation: 探险家们发现了一个古老的洞穴，里面满是史前壁画。

q: The old factory finally _____ production after operating for over fifty years.
explain: ceased (v. 停止/终止 过去式)。
translation: 这家老工厂在运营了五十多年后终于停止了生产。

q: The room felt smaller because the _____ was unusually low.
translation: 这个房间感觉更小，因为天花板异常低。

q: We always _____ the Lunar New Year with a big family dinner.
translation: 我们总是一家人一起吃大餐来庆祝农历新年。

q: The famous _____ was surrounded by fans as soon as she stepped out of the hotel.
translation: 这位著名名人一走出酒店就被粉丝包围了。

q: The human body is made up of trillions of _____, each performing a specific function.
translation: 人体由数万亿个细胞组成，每个细胞都执行特定的功能。

q: I only have ninety-nine _____ left in my pocket, not even a full dollar.
translation: 我口袋里只剩下99美分，连一美元都不到。

q: The ruler shows that this line is exactly ten _____ long.
translation: 尺子显示这条线正好10厘米长。

q: The hotel is located in the _____ business district, making it easy to reach any part of the city.
translation: 这家酒店位于中心的商业区，前往城市的任何地方都很方便。

q: The new shopping mall will be built in the _____ of town, where most people gather on weekends.
translation: 新的购物中心将建在城镇中心，那里周末大多数人都聚集。

q: This ancient castle was built in the twelfth _____ and has survived many wars.
translation: 这座古堡建于12世纪，历经多次战争而幸存。

q: I am _____ that we have met before, though I cannot recall exactly where.
translation: 我确信我们以前见过，尽管我想不起确切地点。

q: You _____ deserve a break after working so hard for the entire month.
translation: 你辛苦工作了整整一个月，当然值得休息一下。

q: After completing the course, she received a _____ that proved her new skills.
translation: 完成课程后，她收到了证明她新技能的证书。

q: He wore a silver _____ around his neck that his grandfather had given him.
translation: 他脖子上戴着一条祖父给他的银链子。

q: Please pull up a _____ and sit down; we need to talk about your progress.
translation: 请拉把椅子坐下，我们需要谈谈你的进展。

q: The _____ of the board called the meeting to order at precisely nine o'clock.
translation: 董事会主席在九点整宣布会议开始。

q: The teacher picked up a piece of white _____ and began writing equations on the blackboard.
translation: 老师拿起一支白粉笔，开始在黑板上写方程式。

q: Climbing this mountain will be the greatest physical _____ you have ever faced.
translation: 攀登这座山将是你面临过的最大身体挑战。

q: The young lawyer decided to _____ the court's decision, believing it was fundamentally unfair.
translation: 这位年轻律师决定质疑法庭的裁决，认为它从根本上就不公平。

q: The defending _____ stepped into the ring to loud applause from the crowd.
translation: 卫冕冠军在观众的雷鸣般掌声中步入赛场。

q: If you get a _____ to study abroad, you should take it without hesitation.
translation: 如果你有机会出国留学，应该毫不犹豫地抓住它。

q: We need to _____ our strategy if we want to succeed in this new market.
translation: 如果我们想在这个新市场取得成功，就需要改变策略。

q: She switched the television to a different _____ to watch the evening news.
translation: 她把电视换到另一个频道看晚间新闻。

q: After the power outage, the office descended into complete _____ as people struggled to continue working.
translation: 停电后，办公室陷入一片混乱，人们努力继续工作。

q: The final _____ of the novel reveals the truth about the mysterious stranger.
translation: 小说的最后一章揭示了那个神秘陌生人的真相。

q: The main _____ in the film is a brave young woman who fights for justice.
translation: 电影中的主角色是一位为正义而战的勇敢年轻女性。

q: Her kindness and patience are the most admirable aspects of her _____.
translation: 她的善良和耐心是她性格中最令人钦佩的方面。

q: A defining _____ of this breed is its gentle and friendly nature.
translation: 这个品种的一个决定性特征是它温和友好的天性。

q: The hotel will _____ an extra fee for early check-in before noon.
translation: 酒店将对中午前提前入住收取额外费用。

q: The police decided to _____ him with theft after reviewing the evidence.
translation: 警方在审查证据后决定以盗窃罪指控他。

q: The annual _____ event raised over a million dollars for local hospitals.
translation: 年度慈善活动为当地医院筹集了超过一百万美元。

q: The scientist plotted the experimental results on a line _____ for easier analysis.
translation: 科学家将实验结果绘制成折线图以便于分析。

q: We sat down for a cup of coffee and had a pleasant _____ about our summer plans.
translation: 我们坐下来喝杯咖啡，愉快地聊起了我们的暑期计划。

q: I love to _____ with my grandmother on the phone every Sunday evening.
translation: 我喜欢每个周日晚上和奶奶在电话里聊天。

q: This restaurant is popular because the food is delicious and surprisingly _____.
translation: 这家餐厅很受欢迎，因为食物既美味又出奇地便宜。

q: It is never acceptable to _____ on an exam, no matter how difficult the subject is.
translation: 在考试中作弊永远是不可接受的，无论科目有多难。

q: Please _____ your answers carefully before handing in the test paper.
translation: 交卷前请仔细检查你的答案。

q: A tear rolled down her _____ as she watched the emotional scene in the movie.
translation: 当她看到电影中感人的场景时，一滴眼泪顺着她的脸颊滚落。

q: The crowd began to _____ loudly when the home team scored the winning goal.
translation: 当主队踢进制胜一球时，观众开始大声欢呼。

q: A loud _____ erupted from the stands as the runner crossed the finish line.
translation: 当赛跑者冲过终点线时，看台上爆发出一阵响亮的欢呼。

q: She added some grated _____ to the pasta sauce to give it a richer flavor.
translation: 她在意大利面酱里加了一些磨碎的奶酪，让它味道更浓郁。

q: The head _____ personally inspected every dish before it left the kitchen.
translation: 主厨亲自检查每道菜，确保它们离开厨房前都完美无缺。

q: The factory was fined for releasing toxic _____ waste into the river.
translation: 这家工厂因向河流排放有毒化学废料而被罚款。

q: The _____ spent years developing a new drug to treat the rare disease.
translation: 这位化学家花了数年开发治疗这种罕见疾病的新药。

q: My favorite subject in school is _____ because I love doing experiments in the lab.
translation: 我在学校最喜欢的科目是化学，因为我喜欢在实验室做实验。

q: He spends his weekends playing _____ with his grandfather in the park.
translation: 他周末和祖父在公园下国际象棋。

q: He placed his hand on his _____ and took a deep breath to calm himself down.
translation: 他把手放在胸口，深吸一口气让自己平静下来。

q: You should _____ your food thoroughly before swallowing to aid digestion.
translation: 你应该在吞咽前充分咀嚼食物，以帮助消化。

q: For dinner, we decided to roast a whole _____ with herbs and lemon.
translation: 晚餐我们决定用香草和柠檬烤一整只鸡。

q: The _____ reason for his success is his willingness to work harder than anyone else.
translation: 他成功的主要原因是他愿意比任何人都更努力地工作。

q: Every _____ deserves a safe and nurturing environment in which to grow and learn.
translation: 每个孩子都应该有一个安全、滋养的环境来成长和学习。

q: The park was filled with laughing _____ running around and playing on the swings.
translation: 公园里满是欢笑的孩子们，他们跑来跑去，在秋千上玩耍。

q: She broke off a piece of dark _____ and slowly savored its rich, bitter taste.
translation: 她掰下一块黑巧克力，慢慢品味它浓郁微苦的味道。

q: After careful consideration, she made the difficult _____ to leave her hometown for college.
translation: 经过深思熟虑，她做出了艰难的选择，离开家乡去上大学。

q: He started to _____ on a piece of bread and needed someone to perform the Heimlich maneuver.
translation: 他开始被一块面包呛住，需要有人做海姆立克急救法。

q: It is hard to _____ between the two options when both seem equally appealing.
translation: 当两个选项看起来同样吸引人时，很难选择。

q: She picked up the _____ with practiced ease and began eating her noodles.
translation: 她熟练地拿起筷子，开始吃面条。

q: The entire audience joined in the _____ of the famous song at the concert.
explain: chorus n. 合唱；合唱队；齐声。
translation: 音乐会上，所有观众一起加入了那首著名歌曲的合唱部分。

q: The protesters began to _____ 'No more delays!' as the politician left the building.
translation: 当那位政治家离开大楼时，抗议者们开始齐声喊道：'不要再拖延了！'

q: The old stone _____ at the top of the hill has been standing for over five hundred years.
translation: 山顶上的那座古老石教堂已经屹立了五百多年。

q: He lit a _____ and stood outside the building, watching the rain fall.
translation: 他点燃一支香烟，站在大楼外面看着雨下。

q: We went to the _____ to watch the latest blockbuster on its opening night.
translation: 我们去了电影院，在首映夜观看最新大片。

q: The children sat in a _____ on the floor, holding hands and singing together.
translation: 孩子们围成一圈坐在地板上，手拉着手一起唱歌。

q: The electrician discovered a short _____ in the wiring that caused the power failure.
translation: 电工发现线路中有一个短路电路，导致了停电。

q: Under no _____ should you give your personal banking information to a stranger over the phone.
explain: circumstances n. 环境；情况（复数）。
translation: 在任何情况下，你都不应该通过电话向陌生人提供你的个人银行信息。

q: The children were excited to see elephants and acrobats at the _____.
translation: 孩子们很兴奋能在马戏团看到大象和杂技演员。

q: You must _____ your sources when writing an academic paper.
translation: 写学术论文时，你必须引用你的来源。

q: Every _____ has the right to vote in the election.
translation: 每个公民都有权在选举中投票。

q: Shanghai is one of the largest _____ in the world.
translation: 上海是世界上最大的城市之一。

q: The lawyer specializes in _____ cases rather than criminal ones.
translation: 这位律师专注于民事案件而非刑事案件。

q: The bomb explosion killed several soldiers and one _____.
translation: 炸弹爆炸导致几名士兵和一名平民死亡。

q: Ancient Egypt was one of the earliest _____ in human history.
explain: civilization n. 文明；文明社会。
translation: 古埃及是人类历史上最早的文明之一。

q: The Indus Valley _____ flourished around 2500 BCE.
translation: 印度河流域文明兴盛于公元前2500年左右。

q: He _____ to have seen a UFO last night, but nobody believed him.
translation: 他声称昨晚看到了不明飞行物，但没人相信他。

q: The audience began to _____ after the wonderful performance.
translation: 精彩的演出结束后，观众开始鼓掌。

q: Could you please _____ your statement? I didn't understand it.
translation: 你能澄清一下你的陈述吗？我没听懂。

q: My English _____ starts at 8 o'clock every morning.
translation: 我的英语课每天早上8点开始。

q: The novel is considered a _____ of modern literature.
translation: 这部小说被认为是现代文学的经典之作。

q: My best friend and _____ helped me with my homework.
translation: 我最好的朋友兼同学帮我做了作业。

q: The _____ was decorated with colorful posters and student artwork.
translation: 教室里装饰着五颜六色的海报和学生作品。

q: The artist shaped the wet _____ into a beautiful vase.
translation: 艺术家将湿黏土塑造成一个美丽的花瓶。

q: Make sure your hands are _____ before you touch the food.
translation: 在接触食物之前，确保你的手是干净的。

q: The instructions were very _____, so everyone understood them.
translation: 说明非常清楚，所以每个人都理解了。

q: The _____ at the front desk checked my passport and gave me the key card.
translation: 前台的职员检查了我的护照，然后给了我房卡。

q: She came up with a _____ solution to the difficult problem.
translation: 她想出了一个解决难题的聪明办法。

q: Please _____ the button to submit your application.
translation: 请点击按钮提交你的申请。

q: The lawyer met with her _____ to discuss the case.
translation: 律师与她的客户会面讨论案件。

q: The _____ in this region is perfect for growing grapes.
translation: 这个地区的气候非常适合种植葡萄。

q: It took them six hours to _____ to the top of the mountain.
translation: 他们花了六个小时爬到山顶。

q: She went to the _____ for her annual check-up.
translation: 她去诊所做年度体检。
